causal_hypothesis: On the same H100, model revision, 32K stock server, fixed 8K/1K workload, and request policy, official GLM MTP/EAGLE improves c8 output throughput by at least 5% without fixed SLO failure or paired output regression.
evidence_scope: Diagnostic intervention evidence only. The frozen absolute stock quality failure from v9 is carried forward; no quality-adjusted economics or provider-competitiveness claim is permitted.

stock_control.absolute_quality_expected: fail under unchanged frozen screen; record and carry forward

admission.stock: exact identities, valid artifact, fixed c1/c8 sequence and SLO pass; absolute quality need not pass for this diagnostic
admission.candidate: same host with at least 1200 seconds remaining
admission.success: candidate fixed sequence passes, c8 throughput improves >=5%, exact normalized text outputs match, paired overall/category non-regression passes, and cleanup passes

quality_gate.absolute: expected frozen failure is not relabeled or recalibrated
quality_gate.paired_text: exact normalized identity for all comparable deterministic outputs
quality_gate.claim_limit: a diagnostic pass shows mechanism speedup only, not quality-adjusted $/token

workload_geometry.semantic_quality: unchanged 32K reasoning-off development capture and self-score in both arms

predictions.candidate_runtime: MTP may fail load on one H100 if the runtime duplicates full model weights; this directly falsifies deployability of the selected integrated configuration.
predictions.candidate_speedup: uncertain; >=5% is the preregistered positive gate
predictions.business_threshold: even a 5% pass remains far short of the roughly 3.1x gain needed for the historical $0.88/M analytical anchor

falsification_rules.mechanism: falsified if candidate cannot load, fixed sequence fails, c8 gain is <5%, paired output identity fails, or paired non-regression fails
falsification_rules.business: no promotion from this experiment alone because absolute quality already failed and no matched external provider exists
falsification_rules.repeat: do not repeat an MTP load/runtime failure unchanged

artifact_contract.cleanup: retrieve and hash before delete; verify instance GET not-found and zero named instances/disks
